hypothesis: The residual failures are all downstream of the store path, but the mechanism is the operand-capture + load-use resolution through the EX/MEM pipeline register rather than the final MEM output. Two coupled defects share one root: (1) ex_stage latches the pre-forwarding register value `idex_rs2_data` (and `idex_rs1_data`) into `exmem_rs2_data`/`exmem_rs1_data` instead of the forwarding_unit outputs `ex_rs2_data`/`ex_rs1_data`, so a store whose rs2 is produced by a preceding ALU result captures the stale register content (0 in the tests) and drives DMEM with 0x00000000 — exactly the t08 symptom where SB 0xaa / SH 0x07aa land as 0x00 giving 0xa5a5a500 / 0xa5a50000, and x7=0. (2) On load-use, hazard_unit resolves the dependency by asserting idex_flush (clearing the ID instruction into a bubble) instead of holding IF/ID (pc_hold + if_flush) and injecting exactly one bubble, so the dependent store is discarded outright and emits no dmem write transaction — the t07 symptom of DMEM write count 0 and DMEM[0x10c] remaining 0xa5a5a5a5, which then makes every later load that reads that word come back stale (x3=0, x12=0xa5a5a5a5, x13=0, x8=0xde). A correct 1-cycle stall places the load result into MEM/WB exactly when the store reaches EX, so forwarding from memwb_wb_data closes the load-use case without MEM-stage dynamic forwarding; the pre-existing power_on_reset failure remains because dmem_valid is a combinational function of an un-initialized EX/MEM valid before the first reset edge a
constraints: Keep the frozen top-level port names, widths and handshake of rv32i5 (clk, rst_n, imem_addr/rdata, dmem_valid/we/addr/wdata/be/rdata, dbg_reg_addr/data, halted, exit_code) unchanged.
Do not change stage port lists or module boundaries already frozen (id_stage/ex_stage/mem_stage/wb_stage/hazard_unit/forwarding_unit interfaces).

dmem write is a single-cycle MEM-stage pulse: dmem_valid & dmem_we assert together exactly one cycle per store, dmem_addr=exmem_alu_result, dmem_wdata = forwarded store data, dmem_be derived from mem_size and low address bits.
Reset is active-low; dmem_valid must be 0 (not X) before the first reset edge, so validity must come from state cleared by rst_n, never from an un-initialized EX/MEM valid.
Load-use must cost at most one stall cycle: hold IF/ID and PC, inject one bubble into ID/EX, never discard the dependent instruction.
Bubbles/flush must be expressed by clearing pipeline valid bits, not by data values; JAL/JALR link value is pc+4.
Do not modify the teacher TB, the spec, or scoring scripts; do not hardcode test vectors or fake debug/feature flags.
